description:
Handlebar featuring Disney Princess favorites! This enchanting design brings sparkle to every ride, with fun details that make every adventure feel like a fairytale come true.
Keep little legs protected with a fully enclosed chain guard that’s as magical as it is practical. Featuring bold Disney Princess graphics, it turns every ride into a fairytale journey
This beautifully decorated seat features enchanting castle and carriage graphics that bring the magic to every mile. With its comfy cushioning and adjustable height, your little rider always stays cozy and confident.
With vibrant decals of Ariel, Tiana, and Cinderella, plus plenty of glittery hearts, crowns, and rainbows, your little one’s ride becomes a rolling fairytale.
These hot pink grips don’t just look magical—they’re crowned with embossed heart and tiara patterns for a touch of princess flair. Paired with dazzling streamers that shimmer as they ride, every handlebar hold feels like a royal wave.

components.description: Safe and Easy to Learn: Coaster brake, training wheels, and a fully enclosed chainguard support new riders with every push.
